description: Summarise a deployment's resource use over time: CPU, CPU throttling, memory and network, each as latest, average and peak, with the API's own labels. Use it to size a version (cpu_units, memory_mb) from a real match, or to check whether a crash was memory or CPU starvation before redeploying. Defaults to the whole life of the deployment.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. Default: now, or when it stopped.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Default: when the deployment started.

step.description: Averaging step, e.g. "30s" or "5m". Default: the API's.

name: edgegap_get_deployment_metrics
title: Get CPU, memory and network use of a deployment
